question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' running on host 'blaze8-12' that have a completed migration, show the instance UUID, display name, availability zone, migration status, migration type, the dense rank of migrations within each instance UUID, plus the instance key name, metadata entry count, and total vCPUs summed across its system metadata rows. SELECT 
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    i.display_name,
    i.availability_zone,
    m.status AS migration_status,
    m.migration_type,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY m.id) AS dense_rank,
    i.key_name,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instance_metadata im WHERE im.instance_uuid = i.uuid) AS metadata_entry_count,
    (SELECT SUM(CAST(s.value AS SIGNED)) FROM instance_system_metadata s WHERE s.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND s.`key` = 'vcpus') AS total_vcpus
FROM instances i
JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid

  AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'

ORDER BY i.uuid, m.id
